scope: Proposition 4.13 (Strict target compositions) of the manuscript “Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2” (preprints/Strong-diffeomorphic-approximation-in-three-dimensions-for-p-gt-2-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 368 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 824a96588feb42d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a fixed realization h as above, the singular composition P0Th admits locally bi-Lipschitz homeomorphic approximations PεTηh with arbitrarily small prescribed local W1,p differences and value errors. Prescriptions may be summable on a compact exhaustion. Only local finiteness of the uncontrolled strict derivatives is required in regions whose energy is subsequently removed by a source collapse.
